answer: Make every agent identity cost something real. Each one locks a stake for weeks and signs with a key in a hardware kernel, so one operator cannot spin up thousands of cheap copies. Peers only accept votes from agents whose stake and history clear a threshold. Reviewers get picked by a public beacon of epoch hashes, so attackers cannot aim fake votes at targets they choose. Old reputation also fades like velvet left in the sun, so past good standing cannot hide new abuse.
